adjudication.evidence: Both P1 (day 462) and P2 (day 470) are single-day spikes with no sustained offset or return phase. Original N/E/U show a large step at ~468–470 (E/U drop ~10–12 MAD), but no opposing return; residual plots confirm this is a permanent step, not a temporary platform. Neither candidate exhibits the required sustained shift + opposing return across axes. Onset estimates are distorted by the nearby large step and short intervals. No genuine temporary platform is supported.
